title: get_findings input

snapshot_id.description: Default is the repository's current snapshot.

subject_ids.description: Only the findings on these symbols.

paths.description: Only the findings in these files, repository-relative. With neither, every finding.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave.

flow_steps.description: Include up to this many ordered analyzer-reported code-flow steps per finding, with individually verified source lines where available.

description: Findings that data-flow and other analysers (CodeQL, Opengrep, ...) wrote as SARIF and a person imported with proofmesh sarif add, each with its tool, rule, level, message, path:line and the innermost symbol at that line; stale (sarif_stale:<name>) when its file changed since the import. Proofmesh runs no analyser. analyze_impact and find_tests rows carry findings=<n>.
